title: BackendSetError lacks From<E> / From<BackendSetError<E>> for JmapError — asymmetric with BackendChangesError, blocks redaction default path
notes:
DECISION NEEDED (triage 2026-10-19 at 9fdbbbcf): Question for Mark: what shape should the foundation crate's structural redaction for BackendSetError take, given that a blanket From<E> overlaps From<SetError>, and that a From-to-JmapError would turn per-object SetErrors into method-level errors (RFC 8620 §5.3)?

Options:
(a) Add a named method and no new From impls. For example `impl<E: Display> BackendSetError<E> { pub fn into_set_error_or_method_error(self) -> Result<SetError, JmapError> }`. The Other arm returns `JmapError::server_fail(SERVER_FAIL_INTERNAL_DESC)`, and the method is additive on a #[non_exhaustive] enum. Size S in jmap-server: about 15 lines plus a test that inner Display text bearing a canary string does not appear in the JmapError, using the existing BackendChangesError test (backend.rs:1337-1378) as the template. Then an optional M sweep converts the hand-rolled matches in the 7 extension crates.
(b) Add a `From<BackendSetError<E>> for JmapError` that debug-asserts against the SetError arm and returns serverFail in release. This gives `?` but hides a semantic footgun.
(c) Keep things as they are. Add rustdoc on BackendSetError naming server_fail_from_backend as the required pattern, and close the bead as a recorded decision. No mechanism is added; all current sites already redact.
(d) Full symmetry at the next major version: drop From<SetError> for an explicit constructor and add From<E> plus From<BackendSetError>. This is breaking.

Recommendation: (a). One method makes the redacted path the obvious one, keeps the per-object vs method-level distinction RFC 8620 §5.3 requires, and is non-breaking. If Mark prefers recording a rule over adding a mechanism, (c) is the cheapest honest close, because no live leak exists.
DECIDED by Mark 2026-10-19: option (a). Add impl<E: Display> BackendSetError<E> { pub fn into_set_error_or_method_error(self) -> Result<SetError, JmapError> } in jmap-server; Other arm -> JmapError::server_fail(SERVER_FAIL_INTERNAL_DESC). No new From impls. Test: canary Display text must not appear in the JmapError (template backend.rs BackendChangesError test). Then sweep hand-rolled matches in the extension crates.
close_reason: Landed as 353524ca (BackendSetError::into_set_error_or_method_error + leak test; mail-server drop-in sites converted). Review passed. CI green at 8e240e18 (stable+beta 3502 passed).
